name: 0codekit
label: 0CodeKit
description: Ready-made utilities for automations: dates and calendar weeks, conversions, validation, PDF and QR tools, file storage, AI text and image analysis, code execution, crypto and short links.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
To get your API key:
1. Log in to your [0CodeKit](https://0codekit.com) account.
2. Open the **Account** tab. Your API key is shown there.
3. Copy the key and paste it here.

generate_qr_code.label: Generate a QRCode
generate_qr_code.description: Create a QR code image (PNG) from text or a link.

data.label: Content
data.description: The text or link to encode in the QR code.

fileName.label: File Name
fileName.description: The name of the generated image file. ".png" is added when missing.

width.label: Width (px)
width.description: The width of the image in pixels. Default is 500.

height.label: Height (px)
height.description: The height of the image in pixels. Default is 500.

margin.label: Margin (px)
margin.description: Empty space around the QR code, in pixels. Default is 15.

errorCorrectionLevel.label: Error Correction Level
errorCorrectionLevel.description: How much of the code can be covered and still read. Default is Q.

dotsType.label: Dot Style
dotsType.description: The shape of the dots that make up the code. Default is square.

dotsColor.label: Dot Color
dotsColor.description: The color of the dots as a hex code. Default is black.

cornersSquareType.label: Corner Square Style
cornersSquareType.description: The shape of the three large corner squares. Default is square.

cornersSquareColor.label: Corner Square Color
cornersSquareColor.description: The color of the corner squares as a hex code. Default is black.

cornersDotType.label: Corner Dot Style
cornersDotType.description: The shape of the dot inside each corner square. Default is square.

cornersDotColor.label: Corner Dot Color
cornersDotColor.description: The color of the corner dots as a hex code. Default is black.

image.label: Logo URL
image.description: A public image link shown in the middle; use a high error correction.

hideBackgroundDots.label: Hide Dots Behind Logo
hideBackgroundDots.description: Remove dots behind the logo (default on); needs a Logo URL.

imageMargin.label: Logo Margin (px)
imageMargin.description: Space around the logo in pixels (default 0); needs a Logo URL.

add_a_global_variable.label: Add a Global Variable
add_a_global_variable.description: Save a value in 0CodeKit so any of your flows can read it later.

variableName.label: Variable Name
variableName.description: The name to store the value under. Empty: 0CodeKit picks one.

variableValue.label: Variable Value
variableValue.description: The value to store. It is saved as text.

get_a_global_variable.label: Get a Global Variable
get_a_global_variable.description: Read the value of a global variable saved in 0CodeKit.

get_a_perm_file.label: Get a Perm File
get_a_perm_file.description: Get a file from 0CodeKit permanent storage so later steps can use it.

linkOnly.label: Link Only
linkOnly.description: Turn on to return only the download link without downloading the file.

crypto_decrypt.label: Crypto Decrypt
crypto_decrypt.description: Decrypt text that was encrypted with a secret key using AES, DES, Triple DES, Rabbit or RC4.

cryptoType.label: Algorithm
cryptoType.description: The cipher to use. Decrypt with the same algorithm and secret key that encrypted the text.

ciphertext.label: Encrypted Text
ciphertext.description: The encrypted text to decrypt, such as the Crypto Encrypt output.

secretKey.label: Secret Key
secretKey.description: The key (passphrase) that was used to encrypt the text.

crypto_encrypt.label: Crypto Encrypt
crypto_encrypt.description: Encrypt text with a secret key using AES, DES, Triple DES, Rabbit or RC4.

cryptoType.label: Algorithm
cryptoType.description: The cipher to use. Decrypt with the same algorithm and secret key that encrypted the text.

secretKey.label: Secret Key
secretKey.description: The key (passphrase) used to encrypt. Keep it safe: you need the same key to decrypt.
